text: {"reconstruction":3,"feasibility":2,"rationale":"The proposal gets the overall goal, the subject and body templates, and the username and role parameters right, but it omits the {blog} parameter, never opens a new tab to visit the blog (it says to find the post \"from profile/website\"), makes the recipient a parameter when it is fixed, adds a \"Users\" filter step that isn't in the true workflow, and ends with Send instead of Discard, so an automation built from it would be vague on the blog step and could send the email."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal, the subject and body templates, and the username and role parameters right, but it omits the {blog} parameter, never opens a new tab to visit the blog (it says to find the post "from profile/website"), makes the recipient a parameter when it is fixed, adds a "Users" filter step that isn't in the true workflow, and ends with Send instead of Discard, so an automation built from it would be vague on the blog step and could send the email.
